purchasingWorkflow.description: End-to-end purchasing lifecycle supported by the application and existing Oracle schema.

actions.action: Create a request with an active department and one or more active products.
Enter a positive quantity and a non-negative estimated unit price for each product.
Save as DRAFT or submit as PENDING.
Record the approver in approved_by and the approval time in approved_at.
Require a rejection reason and store it in the existing notes column.

rules.rule: Only PENDING requests can be approved or rejected.
Approved requests cannot be edited through the request workflow.

actions.action: Create at most one active order for an approved request.
Select an active supplier and specify order quantities and unit prices.
Calculate order value as the sum of quantity multiplied by unit price.

next.condition: order status is ORDERED or PARTIAL

actions.action: Record receipt quantities against purchase order detail lines.
Support multiple receipts against an order for partial delivery.

rules.rule: Cumulative received quantity for a line cannot exceed its ordered quantity.
Set the order to PARTIAL while any quantity remains outstanding.
Set the order to RECEIVED when all active order lines are fully received.

next.condition: order exists and is not CANCELLED

stage.name: Payment

actions.action: Record payment against an active purchase order using an active payment method.
Allow multiple payments so an order can be paid in partial amounts.

rules.rule: Payment amount must be greater than zero.
Cumulative active payments cannot exceed the order total.
Paid amount is the sum of active payments; remaining balance is order total minus paid amount.

stage.paymentStatus: Payments are recorded as individual payment rows; the schema has no separate payment status column.

stage.name: Reports

pages.page: Purchase requests with date and request status filters.
Purchase orders with date and order status filters.
Goods receipts with date and related order status filters.
Supplier order activity with date and related order status filters.
Payments with date and related order status filters.

stage.features: Summary totals and printable report pages.
